plain.li: [opt0,safe] Some merchants broke down on the road, and the council sent me to help. It took all afternoon, but it held. They paid me in goods and a lot of handshakes.
[opt0,risk] I worked on the merchants' repair until dark and it still wouldn't hold. I've gone over it all evening and I still don't know what I missed.
[opt1] We sold the stranded merchants what they needed to fix it themselves. I watched them do it. I'd have done it faster.
[opt2] Merchants broke down on the road today, lashed it together themselves and creaked on. I could have had them moving in an afternoon.

warm.li: [opt0,safe] Helped some stranded merchants today. The youngest of them followed me around all afternoon asking how everything worked.

blunt.li: [opt0,risk] The repair didn't hold. Bad tools, bad light, bad day.

cheerful.li: [opt0,safe] Got some stranded merchants moving again, and they cheered when it held!

gloomy.li: [opt0,risk] Tried to help some stranded merchants. I probably made it worse.

cold.li: [opt0,safe] Repaired the merchants' load. They paid in goods. A fair trade.

plain.li: [opt0] The council sided with {FACTION} in their quarrel with {ENEMY}. I'd have tried talking first.
[opt1] The council sided with {ENEMY} against {FACTION}. I hope it was worth it.
[opt2,safe] I sat between {FACTION} and {ENEMY} all day until they agreed to a split. Neither of them likes the deal. Both of them shook on it.
[opt2,risk] I tried to settle the quarrel between {FACTION} and {ENEMY}. By evening both sides were angry with me as well as with each other.
[opt3] Two of our neighbors asked us to settle a quarrel, and no judgment came from us. Probably wise.

warm.li: [opt2,safe] It took all day, but {FACTION} and {ENEMY} shook hands in the end, and one of them even laughed.

blunt.li: [opt2,risk] Both sides walked out. I'm done playing judge.

cheerful.li: [opt2,safe] I settled a quarrel between two whole peoples today. I'd like that remembered.

cold.li: [opt2,safe] Two neighbors, one dispute, one compromise. They both owe us now.

plain.li: [opt0] I found an old grave today. We buried them again properly, with a stone at the head. I wonder who they were.
[opt1] Found an old grave. The council kept what was buried with them. I can't stop thinking about those bones going back in the ground with nothing.
[opt2] Filled the old grave in again and left it as it was. Whoever it is can go on sleeping.

warm.li: [opt0] We gave the stranger in the old grave a proper burial. I put a few wildflowers on it.

blunt.li: [opt1] Grave goods. Somebody has to use them. Better us than the rats.

gloomy.li: [opt0] Dug up a stranger's grave by accident. One day somebody will dig up mine.

cold.li: [opt1] The grave held a few useful things. The dead have no use for them.

plain.li: [opt0] Two runaways turned up today, {X_nameDef} and {TALE}, and the council let them stay. I found them the warmest blankets we had.
[opt1] We sent {X_nameDef} and {TALE} back to their families. They didn't say a word the whole way.
[opt2] {X_nameDef} and {TALE} thanked us for our time and set off again. I hope they find somewhere that will take them.

warm.li: [opt0] {X_nameDef} and {TALE} are staying. They held hands all through supper.

blunt.li: [opt1] Sending those two home was wrong, and I said so.

cheerful.li: [opt0] We took in a pair of runaway lovers! This place could use some romance.

gloomy.li: [opt2] Two young people in love came to us for help, and went back out on the road.

cold.li: [opt1] Returning the runaways was good for our standing with {FACTION}. Their feelings are their own business.

plain.li: [opt0] My {RELATION} {X_nameDef} came to visit, and the council asked {X_objective} to stay. {X_nameDef} said yes before supper was over.
[opt1] My {RELATION} {X_nameDef} is here for a visit. We talked all day, and tomorrow {X_nameDef} heads home.
[opt1] {X_nameDef} brought news from home and a bag of things I'd forgotten I missed. We walked the fields until dark.

warm.li: [opt1] {X_nameDef} visited today. I didn't realize how much I'd missed my {RELATION}'s laugh.

blunt.li: [opt1] {X_nameDef} visited. A good day. Too short.

cheerful.li: [opt0] My {RELATION} is staying! I'm going to show {X_objective} every corner of this place.

gloomy.li: [opt1] My {RELATION} came to visit, and leaves tomorrow. The place will feel empty after.

cold.li: [opt0] My {RELATION} {X_nameDef} has joined the colony. One more pair of hands, and one I already know.
